name: Daisy Dew's Vacation!
source: Like every summer, Daisy Dew goes on vacation to Nondescriptville, USA, and enjoys a variety of activities that all risk resulting in her somehow losing her clothes in public. Based on the author's [url=https://www.deviantart.com/throwawayforlulz/gallery/64916665/daisy-dew]series of short stories[/url] featuring the same character.
translation: 和每年夏天一样，黛西·露 (Daisy Dew) 前往美国Nondescriptville度假，享受各种活动，但这些活动都有可能导致她在公共场合丢掉衣服。基于作者的 [url=https://www.deviantart.com/throwawayforlulz/gallery/64916665/daisy-dew]系列短篇故事[/url]，以同一角色为特色。
